follow-up time: Until death or 1 year of life
cohort: 88 pregnant women with prenatally diagnosed trisomy 18
finding: Infants with trisomy 18 in this cohort had lower live birth rates and shorter survival than reported in high-income countries, likely due to differences in intrapartum care and neonatal management.
gest_age: Mean gestation at delivery for those continuing pregnancy: 34.8 weeks
